notes.block: Sinhala, U+0D80-U+0DFF. Words are runs of its letters and signs.
notes.notWord: The Sinhala lith digits ෦-෯ (U+0DE6-U+0DEF) and the kunddaliya ෴ (U+0DF4), a punctuation mark, are not word letters.
notes.firstLetter: Independent vowels අ-ඖ and consonants ක-ෆ start a word. The anusvara ං and visarga ඃ follow a vowel (අං), so they are neither first letters nor signs.
notes.joiners: Kept after the al-lakuna: Sinhala writes its yansaya and rakaransaya as al-lakuna + ZWJ + ය or ර (ක්‍රමය, රාජ්‍ය, ශ්‍රී), and without the ZWJ the al-lakuna shows. Text has both forms (ශ්‍රී 23,731 times in the pack's text, ශ්රී 1,100), and some words are right without it (දුම්රිය, a compound), so neither is folded into the other: each is a word with its own count, and the commoner leads. A ZWJ before the al-lakuna (touching letters, ප‍්‍රධාන) is dropped by the engine's normal form.
notes.signs: The al-lakuna and the vowel signs ා-ු, ූ, ෘ-ෟ, ෲ ෳ must follow a consonant. NFC joins the two-part signs (ෙ + ා is ො, ෙ + ් is ේ, ො + ් is ෝ, ෙ + ෟ is ෞ).
notes.replace: ZWNJ is dropped (it appears after an al-lakuna at the end of a word, or in Pali text).
notes.phraseBreaks: Sinhala ends sentences with Latin punctuation; the kunddaliya ෴ is listed for older text.
notes.aksharantar: Aksharantar has no Sinhala. The human pairs are Dakshina's Sinhala lexicon: data/langs/si/pairs.json.
